newsitem.title: GREECE: ECU/DRACHMA PIERCES 303 LEVEL AT FIX ON FOREX BUYING.
newsitem.headline: ECU/DRACHMA PIERCES 303 LEVEL AT FIX ON FOREX BUYING.

text.p: Greek and foreign banks bought a total of 200 million ecus for drachmas at the central bank fixing and ecu/drachma broke the 303 level ending at 303.08 from 302.84 on Thursday.
"It is mainly due to the closing out of positions before the weekend," said a dealer.

"It is obvious to me that the central bank wants to drive ecu/drachma higher to meet its pre-announced 1996 ecu/drachma target at end-December," said another trader. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
